norway-hardangerfjord-fruit-roads.title: Norway · Hardangerfjord Fruit Roads
norway-hardangerfjord-fruit-roads.slogan: A 221 km loop out of Norheimsund fjord
norway-hardangerfjord-fruit-roads.story: Fjord water, orchards and tunnels used carefully. Out of Norheimsund and back again: 221 km, roughly 3 h 49 in the saddle. On the way it passes Steinsdalsfossen, Odda fjord edge and Utne ferry village. The highest point is about 1,200 m. It keeps to quiet secondary roads.
